verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for lunch — 13:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY, I’d treat the Rey Cortiço lunch window (around 13:00) as a check-first option. The wind looks cross-on and the wind fit for this spot is poor, and Surfline consistency isn’t great, so it could get messy quickly—best plan is to check the Surfline cams and the MEO Beachcam for Rey Cortiço before you leave and only commit if it looks noticeably better. There’s a chance the rising tide helps and gives you those punchier sandbank peaks, but I’m keeping it flexible. Cam check first, and cancel if it doesn’t look clean.
